data.one_liner: Mobile customer engagement, analytics, and retention SDK.
data.what_it_does: The WebEngage Flutter SDK offers solutions for mobile customer engagement, analytics, and retention across Android, iOS, and Web. It includes support for push notifications, in-app messaging, and tracking user data.
use_when: You need to integrate WebEngage customer engagement and analytics into a Flutter application
You want to manage push notifications and in-app messages across Android, iOS, and Web
avoid_when: You are looking for a simple local-only notification plugin without third-party backend services
Your app is on a Flutter version older than 3.27 (for version 2.1.0)
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and Web
Modular federated plugin architecture for platform separation
Swift Package Manager support for iOS
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration for native Android and iOS SDKs
Location functionality is split into a separate plugin package
data.setup_notes: Requires native setup for WebEngage Android SDK 5.x and iOS Swift Package Manager integration, along with Flutter 3.27 or later.
